services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Each of the offerings detailed below are available virtually or on-site at JMM's Herbert Bearman Campus. We look forward to welcoming you and your students to the Museum. If you would like to schedule a virtual or in-person program for students, please use the form at the bottom of this page or reach out to JMM's Education Program Manager, Lily Herman: lcherman@jewishmuseummd.org. Description: This virtual visit looks at the history of Eastern European Jewish immigration through Baltimore’s Locust Point Pier between 1889 - 1915.
